notes: A pistol, a bot shooting back and an explicit intent to train for another FPS is the Shooter genre's aim-training case, so Aim Trainer is the preset even though the words practice range never appear. Its usual range-directed shape is wrong here: that is a firing line with everything downrange and nothing behind it, whereas this player dashes around a walled 100x100 baseplate with the bot able to shoot from anywhere, so I took space-bounded and kept the preset's training content. The hoops and random obstacles land as target-practice plus cover-los sightline breakers, the bot is spawner-npc, and I dropped station-loadout because the brief names one pistol and no weapon rack. Without a user I assumed the plain grey box with colourful obstacles from the answers, treated the dash as a movement ability with no geometry, and read the arena as endless practice with no finish to place.
